system.name: Virgo
system.one_liner: a GPU microarchitecture that disaggregates matrix units from SIMT cores to the cluster level for scalable, energy-efficient GEMM execution

components.name: Vortex SIMT Core
components.role: core-coupled baseline SIMT core with detailed pipeline, used to model Tightly-Coupled Tensor Core configurations

components.name: Tensor Core
components.role: core-coupled matrix unit, an optionally instantiated module used for baseline comparisons (dashed box)

components.name: DPU
components.role: dot-product unit inside the Tensor Core

components.name: ALU
components.role: arithmetic logic unit in the core pipeline

components.name: FPU
components.role: floating point unit in the core pipeline

components.name: Fetch & Scheduler
components.role: fetches and schedules warp instructions

components.name: Load/Store Unit
components.role: issues memory load/store instructions

components.name: In Flight
components.role: tracks in-flight load/store requests

components.name: Register File
components.role: holds operand data privatized per warp; exchanges data with the core-coupled Tensor Core

components.name: L1 Inst. Cache
components.role: per-core instruction cache

components.name: Coalescer
components.role: custom unit that merges scalar SIMT memory accesses into wider L1-line-sized requests

components.name: L1 Data Cache
components.role: per-core data cache

components.name: Lane
components.role: SIMT execution lane of the simplified Vortex core

components.name: L1 I-Cache
components.role: per-core instruction cache in the simplified core

components.name: L1 D-Cache
components.role: per-core data cache in the simplified core

components.name: RF
components.role: register file (abbreviated) for the simplified core

components.name: Interconnect
components.role: cluster-local shared-memory interconnect handling concurrent accesses from cores and the matrix unit

components.name: Shared Memory
components.role: software-managed scratchpad divided into banks, shared across cores and the matrix unit

components.name: Bank 0
components.role: one bank of the shared memory

components.name: Bank 1
components.role: one bank of the shared memory

components.name: Bank 2
components.role: one bank of the shared memory

components.name: Bank 3
components.role: one bank of the shared memory

components.name: DMA
components.role: dedicated DMA engine for efficient matrix data movement, also able to draw from the accumulator memory

components.name: Synchronizer
components.role: implements the synchronization mechanism across the cores and the matrix unit

components.name: Gemmini
components.role: systolic-array-based matrix unit IP disaggregated from the SIMT cores into a separate cluster-level unit

components.name: Accum. Memory
components.role: dedicated SRAM storing accumulator matrix data, decoupled from the register file

components.name: Scratchpad
components.role: systolic array's local scratchpad memory

components.name: Systolic Array
components.role: array of processing elements performing matrix multiply-add computation

components.name: Coarse-Grain FSM
components.role: coarse-grain finite state machine controlling the systolic array

components.name: L2 Cache
components.role: cache shared between DRAM and the cluster's cores/DMA

components.name: DRAM
components.role: global memory

content.key_idea: Virgo couples Vortex SIMT cores to a disaggregated Gemmini matrix unit via an interconnect to banked shared memory, plus a dedicated DMA and synchronizer, with color-coded main-memory, shared-memory, and DMA traffic paths.
content.reading_order: left-to-right, top-to-bottom: the two SIMT core variants at left, DRAM/L2 memory hierarchy at top-right, then the cluster interconnect, shared memory, DMA and Gemmini unit below

style.stroke: thin (~0.36pt) black strokes, square corners; dashed strokes mark optionally-instantiated modules such as the core-coupled Tensor Core
style.arrows: thin curved lines color-coded by traffic type (blue = main memory, orange = shared memory, salmon = DMA)

encoding.color_means: blue = main memory traffic (DRAM/L2/L1 path), orange = shared memory traffic (interconnect/banks), salmon = DMA traffic; teal = DPUs inside a Tensor Core, magenta = systolic-array processing elements, colored panel backgrounds distinguish Tensor Core, Shared Memory and Gemmini regions
encoding.line_style_means: dashed boxes/lines mark optionally instantiated modules used only for certain evaluation configurations (e.g., the core-coupled Tensor Core); solid lines are always-present connections
encoding.emphasis: an explicit right-side legend maps three traffic colors so the reader can trace main-memory, shared-memory, and DMA data paths across the whole cluster at a glance
reusable_patterns: whole-system architecture diagram with a color-coded traffic-type legend
dashed modules layered onto the same diagram to denote optional/comparison configurations
weaknesses: very dense (277 shapes, 57 text boxes) with many repeated small blocks (Lane, DPU, In Flight, Bank) that require careful tracing

evidence: Virgo aims to improve scalability and energy efficiency by disaggregating the dedicated matrix unit from the core
we implemented a custom memory coalescing unit as shown in Figure 2.
the same DMA is capable of drawing from the matrix unit's accumulator memory as well

summary: Figure 2 is a detailed whole-system view of Virgo's cluster microarchitecture, built on the open-source Vortex SIMT core and a Gemmini-based matrix unit. Two Vortex SIMT Core variants are shown: a detailed core with ALU/FPU, fetch/scheduler, load/store unit, register file and L1 caches (used for core-coupled Tensor Core baselines), and a simplified Lane-based core; both include an optional dashed 'Tensor Core' with DPUs, since dashed modules denote configurations instantiated only for evaluation. The Virgo Cluster couples these cores through an Interconnect to a banked Shared Memory, a dedicated DMA engine, a Synchronizer, and the disaggregated Gemmini matrix unit (Accum. Memory, Systolic Array, Scratchpad, Coarse-Grain FSM), all backed by an L2 Cache and DRAM. A right-side legend color-codes three traffic types: blue main-memory traffic, orange shared-memory traffic, and salmon DMA traffic.
